description:
The **admin** menu now contains a top‑level link titled **Content**. Its description reads “Manage site content”, and it points to the internal route `system.admin_content` without any additional parameters. Because the parent field is empty, this entry sits directly under the admin menu root. The link is assigned a weight of 0, is enabled, and is not expanded by default. It is provided by the **system** module, and its metadata tags are “admin” and “content”. For caching purposes the system records a single cache tag: `config:system.menu.admin`.

In the **account** menu, a link labelled **My profile** (translation context “User menu”) appears under the parent “user.account”. The description, also scoped to the “User menu” context, states “View your user profile”. This link routes to `entity.user.canonical` with the parameter `{user: 1}`. It carries a weight of 5, is enabled (value 1), and is set to expand automatically. The link is supplied by the **user** module and uses the class `Drupal\user\Plugin\Menu\UserProfileLink`; no form class is defined. Both the metadata and cache‑tag arrays are empty for this entry.
